subject: Sequenced dev webinar — registration tracking matrix & last-mile reminders
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sequenced dev webinar — registration tracking matrix & last-mile reminders

Hi team,

Kicking off planning for the November "Production LLMs: Serving at Scale" dev webinar. I put together a proposed playbook focused on: targeted dev audiences, link-level tracking so we can map clicks -> HS record -> airtable, and a last-mile reminder/snooze flow to reduce no-shows. Please review and flag gaps.

High-level segmentation (seed lists attached):
- Active repo contributors: GitHub activity >= 3 commits/month (seed file: GH_active).
- Trial customers with inference volume > 10k tokens/day (seed file: trial_high_usage).
- Product-Led signups (first 30 days) who opened docs or ran a sample inference.
- Regional waves: US then EMEA (we'll localize subject lines for EMEA).

Tracking/link matrix notes:
- Base UTM: utm_source=newsletter_email, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=prodllm_devnov2026.
- Add utm_content variants: content=A (GH contributors), B (trial power users), C (plg).
- Partner param: partner=edgecloud to credit referrals.
- Add link fingerprint token: lp=<fingerprint> to allow resend dedup and snooze link mapping.
- Keep 3 primary CTAs: Register (primary), View agenda (secondary), Add to calendar.

Reminder cadence (proposed):
- Initial invite -> send day 0.
- Reminder 1: 7 days before event (short, benefits + partners).
- Reminder 2: 48 hours before (agenda highlight + speaker mini-bio).
- Reminder 3: 2 hours before (calendar + join link + phone fallback).
- Snooze: user can "Remind me later" (options: 1 day / 2 hours) — this should swap the lp fingerprint to a different link for analytics.

Copy asks: 3 subject variants (short/engineer-focused, benefit-led, partner co-sell), and 2 body lengths (long explainer + 3-bullet TL;DR). I attached a first-pass UTM matrix and the seedlist CSV.

Open questions:
1) Marissa — can you draft subject/body variants and the HTML snippet for the Register button so we can wire the link params?
2) Vivek — confirm we can append the partner param without breaking our link signing for private tenants.
3) Ops — need final asset delivery date from EdgeCloud for sponsor mention + logo (suggest: Oct 30).

Attachments: 20261024-segmentation-seedlist.csv, utm-tracking-matrix-v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Growth Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Sequenced dev webinar — registration tracking matrix & last-mile reminders

Thanks, Jasmine — this is a solid start. I've sketched three subject lines and two body lengths below, plus a tiny example of the tracking link pattern we'll wire: 

Subject variants (engineer-first):
A) "Ship inference faster: Production LLM serving patterns — Nov 12"
B) "Cost & latency tricks for production LLMs — Live Nov 12"
C) "Redwood x EdgeCloud: Deploying private inference at scale — Nov 12"

Short body (for GH contributors / subject A):
Hi {first_name},
Join a 45-min technical session on practical serving patterns we use at Redwood. Speakers include our runtime lead and an EdgeCloud engineer. Register to get the repo-based cheat sheet.
[Register CTA]

Long body (for trial power users / subject B):
Hi {first_name},
We’ll walk through: inference runtime optimizations, KV cache strategies, and cost controls for production workloads. Live Q&A and a short hands-on demo. Save your spot — limited to engineers and platform teams.
- When: Nov 12, 11am PT
- Why attend: real-world configs, cost tradeoffs, benchmarking artifacts
[Register CTA] [Add to Calendar]

Example tracking link format (replace values server-side):
https://redwood.com/webinar/nov12?utm_source=newsletter_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prodllm_devnov2026&utm_content=A&partner=edgecloud&lp={fingerprint}

Notes: CTA text suggestions — "Reserve your seat", "Get the demo repo", "Join live Q&A".

I'll add the HTML snippet and A/B subject test plan into the Drive doc tonight. Attaching quick mock of the UTMs (utm-tracking-matrix-v1.xlsx).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
